# Authorization data-flow queries (Directive 010)

`<language>/VerificationWithoutAuthorization.ql` reports a success outcome
(exit 0, HTTP 2xx, or a condition guarding a privileged call) that depends on
a verification field (`valid`, `verified`, `accepted`, `quorum_met`,
`official`, ...) when no `authorized` read reaches the same outcome. A
verification result is a precondition, never permission.

```sh
# Seeded bypass corpus (authz-bypass-fixtures.json, generated by make_fixtures.py):
CODEQL_CLI=/path/to/codeql node scripts/check-authorization-dataflow.mjs
# This repository:
CODEQL_CLI=/path/to/codeql node scripts/check-authorization-dataflow.mjs --repo
```

No network is needed: the packs depend on `codeql/<language>-all`, which
ships with the CodeQL CLI bundle. Without a CLI the check exits 2 (fail
closed). Known gaps are listed in docs/COMMAND_AUTHORIZATION.md.
